properties.name: Laos–China Railway (LCR)
properties.description: Standard-gauge high-speed & passenger line: Boten ↔ Vientiane (414 km)

properties.name: Laos–Thailand Railway (Khamsavath)
properties.description: Cross-border metre-gauge line: Vientiane Khamsavath ↔ Nong Khai / Bangkok

properties.name: Vientiane LCR Station
properties.transfer: 14 km NE of city center (~30 min by green shuttle bus or LOCA taxi).

properties.name: Vang Vieng Station
properties.transfer: 4 km east of town (~10 min by tuk-tuk or hotel pickup).

properties.name: Luang Prabang Station
properties.transfer: 12 km east of Old Town (~25 min by shared minivan, ~40,000–60,000 LAK).

properties.name: Muang Xay (Oudomxay) Station
properties.transfer: Gateway to northern Oudomxay and buses toward Nong Khiaw / Phongsaly.

properties.name: Nateuy (Luang Namtha) Station
properties.transfer: 35 km east of Luang Namtha town (~45 min by minivan).

properties.name: Boten Border Station
properties.transfer: Laos–China border crossing; international EMU trains continue to Kunming.

properties.name: Khamsavath Station (Thai Border Link)
properties.transfer: 7 km east of Vientiane center; overnight sleeper trains to/from Bangkok.
